description: ButtonGroup, as the implementation ships it.

curated.by: scaffold --from=code, read from button-group.js, button-group.css, button-group.d.ts

props.name: size
props.notes: The size of the button group. Propagated to all slotted button children.

props.name: orientation
props.notes: The layout direction of the button group. Note: this property does NOT set `aria-orientation` on the host because `aria-orientation` is only meaningful for roles that manage arrow-key navigation (e.g. `toolbar`, `listbox`). Since button-group uses sequential Tab navigation (not roving tabindex), the attribute would be invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Whether all buttons in the group are disabled. When `true`, forces every slotted button child to `disabled`. When `false`, children retain their individual disabled state — a button slotted with `disabled` remains disabled even when the group is enabled.

props.name: align
props.notes: The alignment of buttons within the group along the main axis.

decisions.question: Drafted from the implementation (@adobe/spectrum-wc/components/button-group): 9 rules, 5 declared props, 0 parts. The design file was not consulted.
decisions.chose: code is the source; design is the check
decisions.decision: For a shipped library the stylesheet and the type declarations are the contract. Every token, condition and state here is read from a rule; nothing is transcribed from the design file's layer tree.

decisions.question: Size S sets an 8px gap in shipped code. Was it in the defs?
decisions.decision: No. Shipped code sets --swc-button-group-gap at size S and reads it through a private property, which the drafter does not follow. Raw px because shipped code has no token for it.
